sourceProvenance.geometryOrigin: Original parametric standalone shirt geometry; provenance states no source outfit mesh was imported, isolated, or modified.

garmentTypeAndCoverage.observation: The four views and GLB scene read as a standalone long-sleeve shirt with front placket/buttons and cuff buttons; there is no mannequin or body.

shoulderJoins.observation: The back view is smoother than v2, but dark notches remain at the outer shoulder joins in the front and oblique views; an open-looking dark cutout is clearest at the right shoulder in the oblique view.

collarConstruction.observation: The collar still reads as a small isolated cylindrical band with sharp triangular pieces and visible dark breaks around the neckline; it does not read as one cleanly joined office-shirt collar from front, side, and oblique views.

naturalFabricFolds.observation: Retained from the v2 focused review as directed; the gray render continues to show restrained torso drape suitable for a pressed office shirt.

findings.observation: Dark notches remain at the outer shoulder joins; the right shoulder shows an open-looking dark cutout in the oblique view despite a smoother back silhouette.
findings.expected: A continuous shoulder-to-sleeve transition without visible open gaps, notches, or stray surfaces in the four views.

findings.observation: The stand and leaves remain visually separated by dark breaks; the collar reads as a cylindrical band plus sharp triangles instead of a joined, recognizable office-shirt collar.
findings.expected: A cleanly attached, proportionate shirt collar integrated with the neckline and front panels.

nextAction: Stop geometry after the authorized v3 correction. Lead to decide replan/owner update; no further geometry correction is authorized.
summary: QA độc lập lượt cuối shape ATEL-47/v3: manifest/hash và browser captures hợp lệ. SHAPE-01 vẫn fail vì còn khe tối/notch ở vai ngoài, rõ nhất vai phải từ góc oblique. SHAPE-02 vẫn fail vì cổ còn đọc thành vòng trụ và hai miếng tam giác bị ngắt bởi khe tối, chưa thành cổ sơ mi liền. SHAPE-03 được giữ pass theo chỉ đạo Lead; áo độc lập, có volume, tay dài, khuy và không mannequin. Ghi verdict TRẢ LẠI; dừng geometry theo quyết định đã chốt, chuyển Lead quyết định replan/owner update, không mở thêm correction và không chuyển Material.
